name: Responsive Preview Matrix
blurb: one page at several breakpoints side by side, with overflow flagged
intro: Shows one page in a frame per breakpoint (Tailwind, Bootstrap, Material or your own widths) at its real CSS width, scaled to fit, and flags each width where the document is wider than the viewport, with the elements that stick out. Measuring needs the page on this app's origin; other sites are shown but cannot be inspected.

inputs.label: Page URL
inputs.help: A path on this app (/…) can be measured; another site is only shown.

inputs.label: Overflow report (written by the preview, or pasted)

examples.title: A kit tool page at common device widths
Report from a headless run, Tailwind widths

usage: Give url, preset (common, tailwind, bootstrap, material, reflow or custom with sizes rows {name, width, height}) and optionally report lines '<width> ok|overflow|blocked [sw=<scrollWidth>] [culprit(right px) ...]'. It returns the breakpoint table with device class, media query, overflow in px and culprits, warnings with fixes, a mobile-first media-query skeleton, a Playwright script that screenshots and checks every width, and a DevTools overflow finder. Agents run the Playwright script (or their own browser) and pass its lines as report.
sources: Tailwind CSS default breakpoints; Bootstrap 5 grid breakpoints; Material Design 3 window size classes
